title: Converted formula size bound
statement: Let $V$ be a Boolean PCPP system with $r$ verifier queries, and let $s$ be any seed of its verifier. If $3\le r$, then the size of the converted seed acceptance CNF formula is at most $r2^r$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean PCPP system with $r$ verifier queries
